subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin `memorySearch.extraPaths` ingest arbitrary JSONL raw message logs, or should raw JSONL recall stay outside the builtin Markdown/multimodal path?
rationale: The requested change widens a sensitive memory visibility boundary, and current code/docs already provide separate session-memory and QMD paths rather than arbitrary raw-log ingestion.

options.title: Document the supported alternative
options.body: Keep builtin extraPaths Markdown/multimodal-only and document the QMD, session-memory, converter, or plugin-owned workflow for raw JSONL recall.

options.title: Add native builtin JSONL
options.body: Implement JSONL as a first-class builtin memory format with line-aware parsing, watcher and `memory_get` support, tests, docs, and privacy guardrails.

options.title: Defer to plugin/API design
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers decide whether a plugin or memory API extension should own arbitrary raw-log ingestion.

recommendation.title: Document the supported alternative
recommendation.body: Keep builtin extraPaths Markdown/multimodal-only and document the QMD, session-memory, converter, or plugin-owned workflow for raw JSONL recall.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the memory host/runtime ownership boundary and already reviewed this exact issue.
